accuracy.evidence: Matches KS1 animals grouping: whales/dolphins as mammals (lungs/blowhole, milk, warm-blooded) vs fish (gills, typically eggs); habitat-alone does not determine class.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets water=fish, gills-vs-blowhole, cold-as-sea, and no-milk slips in predictions, notfish step, checklist, challenge why(), and adult notes.

lab_distinct.evidence: Lab is marine-mammal trait sorting and surface breathing — distinct from diet groups (flagdiet herbivore/carnivore) and from living-needs care (flagneeds).

lab_teaches.evidence: Learner must surface-breathe, choose milk, pick warm-blooded, and reject water=fish before confirmation text.

predictions.evidence: Wrong options (fish clue for milk; use gills forever; unable to live in ice) are the slips the next task overturns.

challenge_feedback.evidence: why() names fish-label, gills-only, seaweed-not-milk, always-fish-from-habitat, and grow-gills slips specifically.

readability.evidence: Ages 5–7 wording: short kid lines, concrete whale/dolphin examples, mammal/fish defined by traits in-lab.

no_filler.evidence: No delve/journey phrasing; each line teaches a mammal trait, a fish contrast, or the habitat slip.

mobile.evidence: Large sort and checklist buttons; drag-or-tap twins work at phone width.

accessibility.evidence: Every canvas choice has a button twin; live aria-label via say(); challenge status is aria-live.

sources: UK National Curriculum 2013 Science KS1: Animals including humans — identify and name common animals, describe and compare structure
BBC Bitesize KS1: Animals — mammals and fish trait contrasts (lungs vs gills, milk)
